[1/3] Design 1-click batch launcher, server auto-browser opening, and CLI integration

impact_assessment.why: Add single-click native Windows batch launcher scripts (play.bat, voidfarer.bat) and auto-browser opening to allow instant 1-click game startup as requested by the user
impact_assessment.benefits: Enables friction-free onboarding where users can double-click play.bat to immediately launch the Holographic Web Cockpit HUD and open their default browser, or use terminal REPL/status commands
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLI and REST backward compatibility preserved; dependency: zero external packages; concurrency: thread-safe browser launch timer; state: no state alterations
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure standard library implementation, safe exception catching, and full automated test suite gate verification

[1/5] Architectural domain modeling for time, ticks, orbital mechanics, and time controls

impact_assessment.why: Add simulation time, cosmic stardate ticks, orbital motion, drone time-harvesting, and player time controls as requested by the user
impact_assessment.benefits: Deepens simulation realism with dynamic planetary orbits, autonomous fleet background production over time, dynamic market ebb/flow, and full player agency with pause/speed controls
impact_assessment.risks: contract: REST API and CLI backward-compatible serialization with existing save files; dependency: zero third-party packages, pure stdlib; concurrency: thread-safe engine tick lock during background server ticker; state: save state migration for missing time field
impact_assessment.mitigation: Frozen dataclass TimeState with default factory, engine mutex locking on tick, and comprehensive automated unit tests

[1/4] Deep architectural analysis and planning for state preservation, pause/resume speed memory, and hyperspace transit time

impact_assessment.why: Fix state loss bug where GameState reconstruction resets TimeState to tick 0 across ship actions, preserve speed on pause/resume, advance time during hyperspace jumps, and prevent Web HUD keyrepeat spamming
impact_assessment.benefits: Guarantees temporal state persistence across all actions (orbit, scan, trade, combat, etc.), makes hyperspace travel advance simulation time naturally, remembers chosen speeds across pause toggles, and hardens daemon lifecycle
impact_assessment.risks: contract: preserve all existing REST and CLI return types; dependency: pure standard library; concurrency: thread-safe state cloning; state: no schema migration needed
impact_assessment.mitigation: Implement _clone_state helper to eliminate manual GameState reconstruction errors, add automated unit tests for time persistence across actions, and verify 100% test pass gate
